message: I’m currently in my room, all by myself, being made to reflect on my actions.
The reason is that I broke the ancestral spirit sword.
But it’s not my fault.
「I only put a little bit of effort into it...」
Apparently, I’ve had high spiritual power ever since I was born.
Because of that, I could see Keyou, and I often ended up in a lot of trouble, being talked to or chased around by them.
Seeing that, Father gave me the spirit sword to ward off evil.
「Anyway, didn't Father tell me to try activating it?」
In order to activate the spirit sword, I poured all my spiritual energy into the blade.
And with a *pop*, the spirit sword shattered into pieces.
「I didn't know it would break that easily...」
「And yet, why am I the one getting scolded...！？」
Thinking back on it, I still can't accept it.
So, I decided to run away from home.
「My luggage... yep, this should be fine.」
I stuffed a change of clothes and daily necessities into a large backpack, and I was ready to go.

name: Tsubaki
message: 「...Big sister, big sister Miyako.」

name: Miyako
message: 「Oh, Tsubaki...」
I’ve been caught in a bad situation.

name: Tsubaki
message: 「Big sister Miyako, with such a big bag... are you going out？」

name: Miyako
message: 「I'm not going anywhere, really.」

name: Tsubaki
message: 「You're lying...」

name: Tsubaki
message: 「Because big sister Miyako, you were really angry after fighting with Father.」

name: Tsubaki
message: 「You said you were going to leave in a really loud voice.」

name: Miyako
message: 「Haa, so you heard that, huh...」

name: Tsubaki
message: 「Is big sister Miyako going to leave this house too, just like big sister Momiji and big sister Nadeshiko...？」

name: Miyako
message: 「It can't be helped, you know; my pride is on the line here.」

name: Tsubaki
message: 「Pride？ Pride chicken？」

name: Miyako
message: 「That's not what I meant! A swordsman's honor!」

name: Tsubaki
message: 「I don't really get it...」

name: Miyako
message: 「It's fine, Tsubaki, you don't need to understand」

name: Tsubaki
message: 「It's not fine... I don't want you to leave, Big Sis」

name: Miyako
message: 「I don't know what you expect me to do even if you say you don't want me to」

name: Miyako
message: 「You're you, and I'm me. We're two different people, after all」

name: Tsubaki
message: 「Nooo, I don't wanna be all alone in this house...」
Tsubaki is my younger sister, and she's terribly clingy.
No matter what I do, she always trails after me and wants to copy everything.

name: Tsubaki
message: 「If you're leaving, Big Sis Miyako, then I'm coming with you」

name: Miyako
message: 「Listen, you know that's impossible」

name: Tsubaki
message: 「Ugh... *sniff* Big Sis, Big Sis Miyakooo...！」
She finally started crying.

name: Miyako
message: 「Hey... come on, don't cry. Wipe your tears」
I pulled out a handkerchief and gently wiped Tsubaki's wet cheeks.

name: Tsubaki
message: 「Hic, *sob*... *sniffle*」

name: Miyako
message: 「You're a Suzakuin swordswoman too, aren't you? You shouldn't cry so easily」

name: Tsubaki
message: 「*Sob*... Big Siiis, I wanna go with you too...」

name: Tsubaki
message: 「If I'm not with you, Big Sis Miyako... I don't want it」

name: Miyako
message: 「...Honestly, what am I going to do with you」
Tsubaki, clinging tightly to me and refusing to let go.
Sometimes I do find her a bit of a handful.
Still, Tsubaki was... my one and only precious little sister.

name: Miyako
message: 「...Alright, let's go together」

name: Tsubaki
message: 「Really...！？」

name: Miyako
message: 「I'll take you with me, so get ready in forty seconds」

name: Tsubaki
message: 「F-Forty seconds is impossible!」
Tsubaki, darting back to her room and frantically stuffing her things into a bag.

name: Tsubaki
message: 「*Huff*, *huff*... Big Sis, I'm ready」
She came back in exactly three minutes carrying a large travel bag. I was surprised by how efficient she actually was.

name: Miyako
message: 「Here, give me your bag. I’ll carry it for you.」

name: Tsubaki
message: 「Thank you, Miyako-oneechan!」
With that, the only thing Tsubaki was left carrying was her own small Origami.

name: Tsubaki
message: 「So, sis, where are we going once we leave here？」

name: Miyako
message: 「I haven't really decided on a destination.」

name: Tsubaki
message: 「Will we be okay...?」

name: Miyako
message: 「Tsubaki, we’re swordsmen, remember?」

name: Miyako
message: 「No matter what happens, we’ll make it through with just our swords. Right？」

name: Tsubaki
message: 「Yeah... I get it. As long as you’re with me, I’m sure it’ll be fine.」

name: Miyako
message: 「That’s not what I meant... but oh well.」
It seems Tsubaki still doesn't understand the meaning of “standing on one’s own.”
But I think that’s for the best.

name: Miyako
message: 「Well, don’t worry, I have a place in mind if it comes down to it.」

name: Tsubaki
message: 「Oh, really? Can’t wait~♪」
Everything is ready. Now is the time to leave the house.

name: Miyako
message: 「Alright Tsubaki, let’s go before anyone finds us!」

name: Tsubaki
message: 「Wait, Miyako-oneechan, don’t leave me behind~！」
